title: Maison and the Man-Eating Apartment Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The 47th chapter of Kuu Tanaka and Akima 's Maison and the Man-Eating Apartment ( Hitokui Mansion to Ōya no Maison ) manga revealed on Friday the series will end with its next chapter on December 4.
author: ANN

title: Mitei Hattori's Smile! Manga Gets Epilogue Chapter
content: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. 's Kodama Tales Inc. subsidiary releases the main Smile! manga in English, and it describes the story: Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident.
author: ANN

title: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout Manga Ends With 20th Volume
content: Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story: Nerdy office worker Hinata has once again blundered at a singles mixer, no thanks to his hunky best friend, Jinguji, who's always by his side.
author: ANN

title: Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Stage Play in January
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a stage play adaptation that will run in Tokyo on January 22-24. Masahiko Kawahara is directing the play and Takayuki Kayano is writing the scripts.
author: ANN
